body.name: Fully randomized unequal-scale radial family
body.construction: For \(p=2k\), draw \(X\sim\mathcal N(0,\Sigma)\) with \(\Sigma=\operatorname{diag}\{KI_k-(K-1)\mathbf 1_k\mathbf 1_k^{\mathsf T}/k,I_k\}\). Independently draw \(\varepsilon_0,\varepsilon_1\stackrel{\mathrm{iid}}{\sim}\mathcal N(0,1)\) and \(A\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}(1/2)\). For \(0<h<R-1\), set \(Y_0=\sqrt{R-1}\,\mathbf 1_k^{\mathsf T}X_{1:k}/\sqrt{k}+\varepsilon_0\), \(Y_1=\sqrt{R-h-1}\,\mathbf 1_k^{\mathsf T}X_{1:k}/\sqrt{k}+\varepsilon_1\), and \(Y=AY_1+(1-A)Y_0\). Define \(P_h\) as the resulting joint law of \(A,X,Y_0,Y_1\), whose observed datum is \(O=(A,X,Y)\).
